# Upstream golden fixtures

Outputs of the **original** GENESIS implementation
([yandorazhang/GENESIS](https://github.com/yandorazhang/GENESIS) @ `e4e6894`),
generated by `tools/upstream_oracle/` (see its README for how they are produced,
the exact content of each file, and the platform caveats). Do not edit by hand;
regenerate with `tools/upstream_oracle/run_all.sh`.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `synthetic_small.json.gz` | K = 300 synthetic SNPs: function-level outputs (likelihood, weights, M-step pieces, scores, information) for the 2- and 3-component models, EM traces for 24 scenarios, and the full `genesis()` post-processing (sandwich, BIC, heritability) per scenario. Inputs are stored in the file. |
| `synthetic_medium.json.gz` | same for K = 3000 (matrices truncated to leading rows) |
| `rfuncs.json` | `h2transfer`, `numInterval`, `dmixssnp`, `projection`, `polyriskpredict`, `postmarginal`, `preprocessing`; seeded one-off runs of the RNG-based functions under `stochastic` |
| `mini_chr22_m2.json.gz`, `mini_chr22_m3.json.gz` | genuine `genesis()` fits on `tests/data/mini_chr22/` (chr22 of the reference panel + height GWAS) |
| `mini_chr22_stochastic.json` | seeded `projection(CI = TRUE)` and `qqplotdata.simu()` summaries for the chr22 fits (statistical comparison only) |
| `height_full_m2.json`, `height_full_m3.json` | the full-scale height GWAS runs of upstream's `examples/examples.md` (summaries; no per-SNP arrays beyond the first 200 rows) |

Conventions: doubles carry 17 significant digits (exact round-trip); `"NaN"`,
`"Inf"`, `"-Inf"`, `"NA"` are strings; matrices are arrays of rows; parameter
order is `(pic, sigmasq, a)` and `(pic, p1, sigmasq1, sigmasq2, a)`. The
3-component information matrix `I3` / `m_I` and covariance `var_est` are stored
exactly as upstream returns them, i.e. asymmetric. Generated on arm64 macOS,
where upstream's `long double` is a 64-bit double.
